Victim complex much? The boy(?) who cried wolf.

So, my girlfriend and I were driving through a heavily forested area in Tasmania, Australia. There is a cliff wall on our left hand side and a cliff edge to the right of us. The road is extremely windy as it followed the side of a mountain, and fairly thin, so vehicles need to slow down to a crawl when passing on each other.

I've noticed a yellow camper-van approaching us. My girlfriend casually mentions "watch out...". We are both watching the van as we slowly approach one another. We are about 20 meters away from it when the curve in the road (and the cliff face) obscures the van from view. When we pass the corner... the van is gone!

This is something like the terrain in the area, except we were traveling on a single bidirectional road.

Both my girlfriend look at each other shocked and we are both freaked out! I took a pen from the hire car's glove compartment and, without speaking, write "yellow camper-van" on one of my maps... I then ask my girlfriend to describe what she saw. She describes it as a "yellow camper-van that vanished".

There was nowhere for the van to go. I couldn't have gone off the cliff because of the trees and we would have seen it anyway. It couldn't have turned around and sped off because it was only out of view for two seconds...

I would have discounted this as a hallucination or imagination or false memory... but we witnessed the same thing!

I'm certain it wasn't a false memory because I took the precaution of noting what I saw for that reason. I did this mainly because I have worked for the Police Force and am familiar with the erroneous issues with witness claims and false memories.

This was a weird experience in ways I didn't expect. My girlfriend refused to talk about it immediately afterwards and we never discussed it again and I only mentioned it to my friend for the first time recently. I know that seems odd, but I suspect many people who experience slightly disturbing events are likely to also withdraw about the event.

I just wanted to share this. I feel confident that we witnessed something very unusual and explainable.
